messages.sql: WITH team_stats AS (SELECT team, SUM(matches) AS matches_played, SUM(wins) AS wins, SUM(losses) AS losses, SUM(ties) AS ties, SUM(points) AS points, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs_scored, SUM(overs_faced) AS total_overs_faced, SUM(runs_conceded) AS total_runs_conceded, SUM(overs_bowled) AS total_overs_bowled FROM (SELECT team1 AS team, 1 AS matches, CASE WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS wins, CASE WHEN match_winner = team2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS losses, CASE WHEN match_winner = 'Tie' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ties, CASE WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN 2 WHEN match_winner = 'Tie' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS points, first_ings_score AS runs_scored, 20.0 AS overs_faced, second_ings_score AS runs_conceded, 20.0 AS overs_bowled FROM ipl UNION ALL SELECT team2 AS team, 1 AS matches, CASE WHEN match_winner = team2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS wins, CASE WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS losses, CASE WHEN match_winner = 'Tie' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ties, CASE WHEN match_winner = team2 THEN 2 WHEN match_winner = 'Tie' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS points, second_ings_score AS runs_scored, 20.0 AS overs_faced, first_ings_score AS runs_conceded, 20.0 AS overs_bowled FROM ipl) AS sub GROUP BY team) SELECT team, matches_played, wins, losses, ties, points, ROUND(((total_runs_scored::numeric / NULLIF(total_overs_faced, 0)) - (total_runs_conceded::numeric / NULLIF(total_overs_bowled, 0))), 3) AS net_run_rate FROM team_stats ORDER BY points DESC, net_run_rate DESC;
messages.sql_explanation: The query uses a CTE to normalize the IPL table by treating team1 and team2 as individual entries. It calculates wins, losses, ties, and points (2 for win, 1 for tie) per team. NRR is calculated as (Runs Scored / Overs Faced) - (Runs Conceded / Overs Bowled). Overs are assumed to be 20 per innings as per standard T20 format.
